records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: Let be strong your hands, those hearing in the days these the words these from [the] mouth of the prophets who [were] on [the] day was founded [the] house of Yahweh of hosts, the temple, to be built.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Let your hands be strong, you who in these days are hearing these words from the mouth of the prophets who [spoke] on the day the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts was founded, that the temple might be built.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: Be strong, you who in these days have been hearing these words from the mouths of the prophets, who spoke when the foundation of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies was laid so that the temple could be rebuilt.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: Take courage and keep working! In these days you have been hearing the messages the prophets gave when the foundation of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies was laid, so that the temple could be built again.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Que vos mains soient fortes, vous qui entendez en ces jours ces paroles de la bouche des prophètes qui [parlèrent] le jour où la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées fut fondée, pour que le temple soit bâti.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Soyez forts, vous qui entendez ces jours-ci ces paroles de la bouche des prophètes, ceux qui ont parlé quand on a posé les fondations de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées pour rebâtir le temple.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Courage, continuez le travail ! Ces jours-ci, vous avez entendu les messages que les prophètes ont donnés quand on a posé les fondations du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, pour qu’il soit reconstruit.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Fortalézcanse {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que oyen|vosotros que oís}} en estos días estas palabras de boca de los profetas que [hablaron] el día en que se echaron los cimientos de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, para que se edificara el templo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: {{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que en estos días han oído|vosotros que en estos días habéis oído}} estas palabras de boca de los profetas que hablaron cuando se echaron los cimientos de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, para que el templo fuera reedificado.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: ¡{{plural_you:Anímense y sigan|Animaos y seguid}} trabajando! En estos días {{plural_you:han oído|habéis oído}} los mensajes que dieron los profetas cuando se echaron los cimientos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, para que el templo se construyera de nuevo.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Hãy làm cho tay các ngươi mạnh mẽ, hỡi các ngươi là những người trong những ngày này đang nghe những lời này từ miệng các nhà tiên tri, [là những người đã nói] vào ngày nền nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân được đặt, để đền thờ được xây dựng.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Hãy vững mạnh lên, hỡi các ngươi là những người trong những ngày này đã nghe những lời này từ miệng các nhà tiên tri, là những người đã nói khi nền nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân được đặt để đền thờ được xây lại.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Hãy can đảm lên và tiếp tục làm việc! Trong những ngày này các ngươi đã nghe những sứ điệp mà các nhà tiên tri đã rao truyền khi nền đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân được đặt, để đền thờ được xây lại.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Mikono yenu na iwe hodari, ninyi mnaosikia katika siku hizi maneno haya kutoka kinywani mwa manabii waliokuwepo siku ile msingi wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ulipowekwa, ili hekalu lijengwe.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Iweni hodari, ninyi ambao katika siku hizi mmekuwa mkisikia maneno haya kutoka vinywani mwa manabii, waliosema wakati msingi wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ulipowekwa ili hekalu lijengwe upya.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Jipeni moyo, mwendelee kufanya kazi! Siku hizi mmekuwa mkisikia ujumbe ambao manabii walitoa wakati msingi wa hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ulipowekwa, ili hekalu lijengwe tena.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희 손을 강하게 하여라. 이날들에 이 말씀들을 예언자들의 입에서 듣고 있는 너희여, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집, 곧 성전을 지으려고 그 기초를 놓던 날에 [말한] 예언자들의 입에서 듣는 너희여.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 힘을 내어라. 너희는 요즈음 예언자들의 입에서 이 말씀을 들어 왔다. 그 예언자들은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 기초를 놓아 성전을 다시 지으려고 할 때 말한 사람들이다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 용기를 내어 계속 일하여라! 너희는 요즈음 예언자들이 전한 말씀을 들어 왔다. 그 예언자들은 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 기초를 놓을 때, 성전을 다시 짓게 하려고 그 말씀을 전했다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Que as mãos de vocês sejam fortes, vocês que nestes dias estão ouvindo estas palavras da boca dos profetas que [falaram] no dia em que foi fundada a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, para que o templo fosse edificado.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Sejam fortes, vocês que nestes dias têm ouvido estas palavras da boca dos profetas, que falaram quando foram lançados os alicerces da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, para que o templo fosse reconstruído.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: Tenham coragem e continuem trabalhando! Nestes dias vocês têm ouvido as mensagens que os profetas deram quando foram lançados os alicerces do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, para que o templo fosse construído de novo.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ ቤተ መቅደሱ ይሠራ ዘንድ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጸባኦት ቤት መሠረት በተጣለበት ቀን ከነበሩት ነቢያት አፍ እነዚህን ቃሎች በዚህ ዘመን የምትሰሙ እናንተ፣ እጆቻችሁ ይበርቱ።
am.B: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ቤተ መቅደሱ እንደ ገና እንዲሠራ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤት መሠረት በተጣለ ጊዜ ከተናገሩት ነቢያት አፍ እነዚህን ቃሎች በዚህ ዘመን የሰማችሁ እናንተ፣ በርቱ።
am.R: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ አይዟችሁ፤ ሥራችሁንም ቀጥሉ! የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት በተጣለ ጊዜ ነቢያቱ የሰጡትን መልእክት በዚህ ዘመን ሰምታችኋል። መሠረቱ የተጣለውም ቤተ መቅደሱ እንደ ገና እንዲሠራ ነበር።

hi.L: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: तुम्हारे हाथ दृढ़ हों, तुम जो इन दिनों में ये वचन उन भविष्यद्वक्ताओं के मुँह से सुन रहे हो जो उस दिन [बोले] जब सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की नींव डाली गई, कि मन्दिर बनाया जाए।
hi.B: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: हियाव बाँधो, तुम जो इन दिनों में भविष्यद्वक्ताओं के मुँह से ये वचन सुनते आए हो, जो उस समय बोले थे जब सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की नींव डाली गई थी, ताकि मन्दिर फिर से बनाया जाए।
hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: हिम्मत रखो और काम करते रहो! इन दिनों में तुम वे संदेश सुनते आए हो जो नबियों ने उस समय दिए थे जब सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर की नींव डाली गई थी, ताकि मन्दिर फिर से बनाया जाए।

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Да укрепятся ваши руки, слышащие в эти дни эти слова из уст пророков, которые [были] в день основания дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа, чтобы храм был построен.
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Будьте крепки, вы, кто в эти дни слышал эти слова из уст пророков, которые говорили, когда закладывали основание дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа, чтобы отстроить храм.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств: Мужайтесь и продолжайте работать! В эти дни вы слышали вести, которые передали пророки, когда закладывали основание храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Воинств, чтобы снова построить храм.

uk.L: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот: Нехай зміцняться ваші руки, ви, що в ці дні чуєте ці слова з уст пророків, [які говорили] того дня, коли було закладено основу дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Саваота, щоб храм був збудований.
uk.B: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ: Будьте сильні, ви, що в ці дні чуєте ці слова з уст пророків, які говорили, коли було закладено основу дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, щоб храм можна було відбудувати.
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель: Будьте мужні й працюйте далі! У ці дні ви чуєте послання, які пророки проголошували, коли було закладено основу храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Вседержителя, щоб храм можна було збудувати знову.

decisions.choice: let your hands be strong: take courage and keep at the work
decisions.reason: Strong hands are hands that do not drop the work in discouragement (Judges 7:11; 2 Samuel 2:7). Haggai used the same call for the builders (Haggai 2:4), and verse 13 repeats it.

decisions.choice: the prophets on the day the house was founded: Haggai and Zechariah
decisions.reason: Haggai and Zechariah urged the people to rebuild (Ezra 5:1-2). Haggai dates the laying of the foundation to the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month in Darius's second year, December 520 BC (Haggai 2:18), about two years before this message.

decisions.choice: Be strong (B); Take courage and keep working (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means. Readable splits the long sentence and says "temple" for "house".

decisions.choice: "qui [parlèrent]", "fut fondée" (L) for the day of the founding
decisions.reason: A dated past event set apart from the speaker's present; Balanced and Readable use the passé composé of speech, as the term sheet sets for oracles.

decisions.choice: "Fortalézcanse sus manos" (L); "Esfuércense" (B); "Anímense y sigan trabajando" (R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the image of strong hands; B and R give its sense, the call to courage in the work, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Hãy làm cho tay các ngươi mạnh mẽ" (L) / "Hãy vững mạnh lên" (B) / "Hãy can đảm lên và tiếp tục làm việc" (R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the image of the hands; B and R say what it means.

decisions.choice: "Mikono yenu na iwe hodari" (L); "Iweni hodari" (B); "Jipeni moyo, mwendelee kufanya kazi" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew image of strong hands; the other levels give its sense, courage to go on with the work, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "힘을 내어라" (B); "용기를 내어 계속 일하여라" (R)
decisions.reason: "Let your hands be strong" means take courage and keep working (meaning decision); Literal keeps "너희 손을 강하게 하여라".

decisions.choice: Que as mãos de vocês sejam fortes (L); Sejam fortes (B); Tenham coragem e continuem trabalhando (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of strong hands (m1); Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does (r-en-1); verse 13 repeats each level's words.

decisions.choice: "let your hands be strong" as "እጆቻችሁ ይበርቱ" (L, and B in 8:13), "በርቱ" (B), "አይዟችሁ፤ ሥራችሁንም ቀጥሉ!" (R), here and in 8:13
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's hands; Readable says what the idiom asks, courage to keep at the work, as the English Readable does. "In these days" is "በዚህ ዘመን", the counterpart of "በዚያ ዘመን".

decisions.choice: तुम्हारे हाथ दृढ़ हों (L); हियाव बाँधो (B); हिम्मत रखो और काम करते रहो (R)
decisions.reason: "Let your hands be strong" means take courage and keep at the work (meaning m1). Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, and Readable adds "keep working", as the English does. Verse 13 repeats the call with the same wording.

decisions.choice: Да укрепятся ваши руки (L); Будьте крепки (B); Мужайтесь и продолжайте работать (R)
decisions.reason: "Let your hands be strong" means take courage and keep at the work (m1); Literal keeps the hands, the other levels say the sense, as the English does.

source.text: כִּ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ הַיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם שְׂכַ֤ר הָֽאָדָם֙ לֹ֣א נִֽהְיָ֔ה וּשְׂכַ֥ר הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֵינֶ֑נָּה וְלַיּוֹצֵ֨א וְלַבָּ֤א אֵין־שָׁלוֹם֙ מִן־הַצָּ֔ר וַאֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־כָּל־הָאָדָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּרֵעֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For before the days those [the] wage of man was not, and [the] wage of beast was not; and for the one going out and for the one coming in there was no peace from the foe; and I sent all men each against his neighbor.

en.L: For before those days there were no wages for man, and there were no wages for beast; and for the one going out and the one coming in there was no peace because of the foe; and I set all people, each against {{gender:their|his}} neighbor.
en.B: For before that time there were no wages for people or for animals. No one could go out or come in safely because of the enemy, and I had set everyone against {{gender:their|his}} neighbor.
en.R: Before that time no one was paid for work, whether a person or an animal. No one could travel safely because of enemies. I had turned everyone against each other.

fr.L: Car avant ces jours-là, il n’y avait pas de salaire pour {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}, et il n’y avait pas de salaire pour la bête ; et pour celui qui sortait et pour celui qui entrait, il n’y avait pas de paix à cause de l’adversaire ; et j’ai lâché {{gender:tout le monde|tous les hommes}}, chacun contre son prochain.
fr.B: Car avant ce temps-là, il n’y avait pas de salaire pour les hommes ni pour les bêtes. Personne ne pouvait sortir ou rentrer en sécurité à cause de l’ennemi, et j’avais dressé chacun contre son prochain.
fr.R: Avant ce temps-là, personne n’était payé pour son travail, ni les gens ni les animaux. Personne ne pouvait voyager en sécurité à cause des ennemis. J’avais dressé les gens les uns contre les autres.

es.L: Porque antes de aquellos días no había salario para el hombre, ni había salario para la bestia; y para el que salía y para el que entraba no había paz a causa del enemigo; y yo puse a todos, cada uno contra su prójimo.
es.B: Porque antes de aquel tiempo no había paga ni para las personas ni para los animales. Nadie podía salir ni entrar seguro por causa del enemigo, y yo había puesto a cada uno contra su prójimo.
es.R: Antes de aquel tiempo nadie recibía paga por su trabajo, ni las personas ni los animales. Nadie podía viajar seguro por causa de los enemigos. Yo había hecho que todos se pusieran unos contra otros.

vi.L: Vì trước những ngày ấy, không có tiền công cho người, cũng không có tiền công cho súc vật; người đi ra và người đi vào đều không được bình an vì kẻ thù; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã khiến mọi người, ai nấy chống lại người lân cận mình.
vi.B: Vì trước thời ấy, không có tiền công cho người hay cho súc vật. Không ai có thể ra vào an toàn vì kẻ thù, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã khiến mọi người chống lại người lân cận mình.
vi.R: Trước thời ấy, không ai được trả công, dù là người hay súc vật. Không ai có thể đi lại an toàn vì kẻ thù. Ta đã khiến mọi người chống lại nhau.

sw.L: Kwa maana kabla ya siku hizo hapakuwa na mshahara kwa mtu, wala hapakuwa na mshahara kwa mnyama; wala kwa yule anayetoka na yule anayeingia hapakuwa na amani kwa sababu ya adui; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} niliwaacha watu wote, kila mtu dhidi ya jirani yake.
sw.B: Kwa maana kabla ya wakati huo hapakuwa na ujira kwa watu wala kwa wanyama. Hakuna aliyeweza kutoka wala kuingia salama kwa sababu ya adui, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nilikuwa nimemfanya kila mtu kuwa adui wa jirani yake.
sw.R: Kabla ya wakati huo hakuna aliyelipwa kwa kazi yake, iwe mtu au mnyama. Hakuna aliyeweza kusafiri salama kwa sababu ya maadui. Nilikuwa nimewafanya watu wote wagombane wao kwa wao.

ko.L: 그날들 이전에는 사람의 품삯이 없었고, 짐승의 삯도 없었다. 나가는 자에게도 들어오는 자에게도 대적 때문에 평안이 없었다. 내가 모든 사람을 서로 자기 이웃을 치게 하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그때 이전에는 사람도 짐승도 품삯을 받지 못했다. 원수 때문에 아무도 안심하고 드나들 수 없었다. 내가 모든 사람을 서로 이웃과 맞서게 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그때 전에는 사람이든 짐승이든 일한 대가를 받지 못했다. 원수들 때문에 아무도 마음 놓고 다닐 수 없었다. 내가 사람들을 서로 싸우게 했기 때문이다.

pt.L: Porque antes daqueles dias não havia salário para o homem, e não havia salário para o animal; e para quem saía e para quem entrava não havia paz por causa do inimigo; e lancei todas as pessoas, cada uma contra o seu próximo.
pt.B: Porque antes daquele tempo não havia salário nem para as pessoas nem para os animais. Ninguém podia sair nem entrar em segurança por causa do inimigo, e eu tinha jogado todos uns contra os outros.
pt.R: Antes daquele tempo ninguém recebia pelo seu trabalho, nem as pessoas nem os animais. Ninguém podia viajar em segurança por causa dos inimigos. Eu tinha jogado todos uns contra os outros.

am.L: ከእነዚያ ቀኖች በፊት ለሰው ደመወዝ፣ ለእንስሳም ደመወዝ አልነበረምና፤ ለሚወጣውና ለሚገባውም ከጠላት የተነሣ ሰላም አልነበረም፤ ሰዎችንም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱን በባልንጀራው ላይ አስነሣሁ።
am.B: ከዚያ ጊዜ በፊት ለሰውም ለእንስሳም ደመወዝ አልነበረም። ከጠላት የተነሣ ማንም በሰላም ሊወጣና ሊገባ አይችልም ነበር፤ እኔም እያንዳንዱን በባልንጀራው ላይ አስነሥቼ ነበር።
am.R: ከዚያ ጊዜ በፊት ሰውም ሆነ እንስሳ ለሥራው ዋጋ አይከፈለውም ነበር። ከጠላቶች የተነሣ ማንም በሰላም መጓዝ አይችልም ነበር። እኔም ሰዎችን እርስ በርሳቸው አጣልቼ ነበር።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन दिनों से पहले न मनुष्य की मज़दूरी थी, और न पशु की मज़दूरी; और बाहर जानेवाले और भीतर आनेवाले के लिए बैरी के कारण कोई शान्ति न थी; और मैंने सब मनुष्यों को, हर एक को अपने पड़ोसी के विरुद्ध कर दिया।
hi.B: क्योंकि उस समय से पहले न मनुष्यों को मज़दूरी मिलती थी, न पशुओं को। शत्रु के कारण कोई सुरक्षित बाहर-भीतर आ-जा नहीं सकता था, और मैंने हर एक को अपने पड़ोसी के विरुद्ध कर दिया था।
hi.R: उस समय से पहले किसी को काम की मज़दूरी नहीं मिलती थी, न मनुष्य को, न पशु को। शत्रुओं के कारण कोई सुरक्षित यात्रा नहीं कर सकता था। मैंने सब लोगों को एक-दूसरे के विरुद्ध कर दिया था।

ru.L: Ведь до тех дней не было платы человеку и платы скоту не было; и выходящему и входящему не было мира от врага; и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пустил всех людей, каждого против его ближнего.
ru.B: Ведь до того времени не было заработка ни людям, ни скоту. Никто не мог спокойно выйти или войти из-за врага, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} восстановил всех друг против друга.
ru.R: До того времени никому не платили за работу, ни человеку, ни животному. Никто не мог безопасно ходить из-за врагов. Я восстановил всех друг против друга.

uk.L: Бо перед тими днями не було заробітку для людини, і не було заробітку для худоби; і тому, хто виходив, і тому, хто входив, не було миру через ворога; і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} настроїв усіх людей, кожного проти свого ближнього.
uk.B: Бо до того часу не було заробітку ні для людей, ні для тварин. Ніхто не міг безпечно вийти чи ввійти через ворога, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} настроїв кожного проти свого ближнього.
uk.R: До того часу ніхто не отримував плати за працю, ні людина, ні тварина. Ніхто не міг безпечно подорожувати через ворогів. Я настроїв усіх одне проти одного.

decisions.choice: no wages for people or animals: the hard years before the work on the temple began again
decisions.reason: Haggai describes the same years: people sowed much and harvested little, and those who earned wages put them into a purse with holes (Haggai 1:6, 9-11; 2:15-17). The work of people and of animals brought no return.

decisions.choice: peace: safety
decisions.reason: The word *shalom* means wholeness and well-being; here, going out and coming in safely, without danger from enemies.

decisions.choice: the one going out and the one coming in: anyone going about daily life
decisions.reason: "Going out and coming in" covers all of daily life, work and travel (Deuteronomy 28:6; Psalm 121:8).

decisions.choice: I set everyone against their neighbor: strife among the people was part of God's judgment
decisions.reason: The LORD says that he let loose the quarrels that divided the community. The same disorder is described as judgment in Isaiah 19:2.

decisions.choice: their / his (L, B); each other (R); safely (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Each against his neighbor" means everyone, so the pronoun takes the gender setting. Balanced and Readable say "safely" for "there was no peace", as m2 explains. Readable says "travel" for "going out and coming in".

decisions.choice: {{gender:l'être humain|l'homme}} and {{gender:tout le monde|tous les hommes}} (L), on the nouns for ʾadam; "chacun contre son prochain" with no span
decisions.reason: French puts the setting on the nouns, as the style guide says, where the English puts it on the pronoun "their".

decisions.choice: "les hommes ni ... les bêtes" (B) with no span
decisions.reason: Paired with the animals, "les hommes" means human beings as against beasts; Literal carries the setting.

decisions.choice: "cada uno contra su prójimo"
decisions.reason: Spanish "cada uno" and "su" cover both readings of the English gender setting, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: cada uma contra o seu próximo (L); todos uns contra os outros (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: cada homem contra o seu próximo
decisions.reason: The English puts "his neighbor" under the gender setting at Literal and Balanced (r-en-1). Portuguese "todas as pessoas, cada uma contra o seu próximo" (L) and "uns contra os outros" (B, R) are already inclusive (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 7), so there is no span. "O homem" at Literal is the human being set against the animal, as the gloss has it.

decisions.choice: "እያንዳንዱን በባልንጀራው ላይ" (each against his neighbour) with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span like the English one
decisions.reason: "ባልንጀራ" (neighbour) and Amharic's generic suffix include women and men, so the English their / his choice has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: हर एक को अपने पड़ोसी के विरुद्ध, without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "their / his neighbor" under the gender setting. Hindi हर एक and the reflexive अपने already include women and men, so the Hindi has no span. "Peace" here means safety (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: каждого против его ближнего (L); всех друг против друга (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a gender setting for "their / his neighbor"; the Russian wording names no gender, so no span is needed.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה לֹ֣א כַיָּמִ֤ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִים֙ אֲנִ֔י לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And now not like the days the former [am] I to [the] remnant of the people this, declaration of Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: But now, not as in the former days [am] I to the remnant of this people, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the former days, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: But now I will not treat the people who are left the way I treated them before, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Mais maintenant, je ne [suis] pas comme aux jours d’autrefois envers le reste de ce peuple, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Mais maintenant, je n’agirai plus envers le reste de ce peuple comme dans les jours d’autrefois, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Mais maintenant, je ne traiterai plus les survivants de ce peuple comme je les ai traités avant, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Pero ahora no [seré] yo para el remanente de este pueblo como en los días anteriores, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Pero ahora no trataré al remanente de este pueblo como en los días pasados, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Pero ahora no trataré a los que queden del pueblo como los traté antes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

vi.L: Nhưng nay, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không [đối xử] với những người sót lại của dân này như trong những ngày trước, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.B: Nhưng nay, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không đối xử với những người sót lại của dân này như trong những ngày trước nữa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy.
vi.R: Nhưng bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không đối xử với những người còn sống sót như trước kia nữa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

sw.L: Lakini sasa, si kama katika siku za kwanza [nilivyo] {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} kwa mabaki ya watu hawa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Lakini sasa sitawatendea mabaki ya watu hawa kama nilivyowatendea siku za kwanza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Lakini sasa sitawatendea watu waliobaki kama nilivyowatendea zamani, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

ko.L: 그러나 이제 나는 이 백성의 남은 자에게 이전 날들과 같지 않다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그러나 이제 나는 이 백성 가운데 남은 사람들을 이전처럼 대하지 않겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그러나 이제 나는 살아남은 사람들을 전처럼 대하지 않겠다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Mas agora não [sou] eu para o remanescente deste povo como nos dias anteriores, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Mas agora não vou tratar o remanescente deste povo como nos dias passados, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Mas agora não vou tratar as pessoas que restaram como eu as tratava antes, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: አሁን ግን ለዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ እንደ ቀድሞው ዘመን አይደለሁም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: አሁን ግን በቀድሞው ዘመን እንዳደረግኩት በዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ላይ አላደርግም፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: አሁን ግን የቀሩትን ሰዎች ቀድሞ እንዳደረግኳቸው አላደርጋቸውም፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: पर अब मैं इस प्रजा के बचे हुए लोगों के लिए पहले के दिनों के समान नहीं [हूँ], सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: पर अब मैं इस प्रजा के बचे हुए लोगों से वैसा व्यवहार नहीं करूँगा जैसा मैंने पहले के दिनों में किया था, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: पर अब मैं उन लोगों से जो बच गए हैं, वैसा व्यवहार नहीं करूँगा जैसा पहले किया था, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: А теперь не так, как в прежние дни, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} [буду] для остатка этого народа, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа.
ru.B: Но теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не буду поступать с остатком этого народа так, как в прежние дни, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Но теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не буду поступать с теми, кто остался из народа, так, как поступал раньше, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

uk.L: А тепер не як у давніші дні [буду] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} для залишку цього народу, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: А тепер {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не поводитимуся з залишком цього народу так, як у давніші дні, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Але тепер {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не поводитимуся з людьми, що залишилися, так, як поводився з ними раніше, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: but now: the turning point from the hard past to the promised future
decisions.reason: "Now" sets the present against "those days" of verse 10. The verse has no verb; "I am not ... as in the former days" means "I will not deal with them as before". The emphatic "I" stresses that the change comes from the LORD.

decisions.choice: deal with (B); treat (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply a verb, which the Hebrew leaves out. Readable says "the people who are left" for the remnant.

source.text: כִּֽי־זֶ֣רַע הַשָּׁל֗וֹם הַגֶּ֜פֶן תִּתֵּ֤ן פִּרְיָהּ֙ וְהָאָ֨רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְהַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִתְּנ֣וּ טַלָּ֑ם וְהִנְחַלְתִּ֗י אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֛ית הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה אֶת־כָּל־אֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: For [there will be] the seed of peace: the vine will give its fruit, and the land will give its produce, and the heavens will give their dew; and I will cause to inherit the remnant of the people this all these.

en.L: For [there will be] the seed of peace: the vine will give its fruit, and the land will give its produce, and the heavens will give their dew; and I will give the remnant of this people all these [things] as a possession.
en.B: For there will be a sowing of peace: the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will give its crops, and the sky will give its dew. I will give all these things to the remnant of this people as their own.
en.R: The seeds will grow in peace. The grapevines will produce grapes. The ground will produce crops, and dew will fall from the sky. I will give all these good things to the people who are left.

fr.L: Car [il y aura] la semence de la paix : la vigne donnera son fruit, et la terre donnera son produit, et les cieux donneront leur rosée ; et je ferai hériter au reste de ce peuple toutes ces [choses].
fr.B: Car les semailles se feront dans la paix : la vigne donnera son fruit, la terre ses récoltes, et le ciel sa rosée. Je donnerai tout cela en héritage au reste de ce peuple.
fr.R: Les semences pousseront en paix. Les vignes donneront des raisins. La terre produira des récoltes, et la rosée tombera du ciel. Je donnerai toutes ces bonnes choses aux survivants de ce peuple.

es.L: Porque [habrá] simiente de paz: la vid dará su fruto, y la tierra dará su producto, y los cielos darán su rocío; y haré que el remanente de este pueblo posea todas estas [cosas].
es.B: Porque habrá una siembra de paz: la vid dará su fruto, la tierra dará sus cosechas y el cielo dará su rocío. Todo esto le daré al remanente de este pueblo como herencia.
es.R: Las semillas crecerán en paz. Las vides darán uvas. La tierra dará sus cosechas, y caerá rocío del cielo. Todas estas cosas buenas se las daré a los que queden del pueblo.

vi.L: Vì [sẽ có] hạt giống của bình an: cây nho sẽ ra trái, đất sẽ sinh hoa lợi, và trời sẽ cho sương móc; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho những người sót lại của dân này được hưởng mọi [điều] ấy làm sản nghiệp.
vi.B: Vì sẽ có mùa gieo trồng bình an: cây nho sẽ ra trái, đất sẽ sinh hoa màu, và trời sẽ cho sương móc. Ta sẽ ban mọi điều ấy cho những người sót lại của dân này làm của riêng.
vi.R: Hạt giống sẽ lớn lên trong bình an. Cây nho sẽ ra trái. Đất sẽ sinh hoa màu, và sương sẽ rơi từ trời. Ta sẽ ban mọi điều tốt lành ấy cho những người còn sống sót.

sw.L: Kwa maana [kutakuwa na] mbegu ya amani: mzabibu utatoa tunda lake, nayo nchi itatoa mazao yake, nazo mbingu zitatoa umande wake; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawarithisha mabaki ya watu hawa [vitu] hivi vyote.
sw.B: Kwa maana mbegu zitapandwa kwa amani: mzabibu utazaa matunda yake, ardhi itatoa mazao yake, na anga litatoa umande wake. Nitawapa mabaki ya watu hawa vitu hivi vyote viwe mali yao.
sw.R: Mbegu zitaota kwa amani. Mizabibu itazaa zabibu. Ardhi itatoa mazao, na umande utashuka kutoka angani. Nitawapa watu waliobaki mema haya yote.

ko.L: 평화의 씨앗이 [있을 것이다]. 포도나무가 열매를 맺고, 땅이 소출을 내며, 하늘이 이슬을 내릴 것이다. 내가 이 백성의 남은 자에게 이 모든 것을 차지하게 하겠다.
ko.B: 평화롭게 씨를 뿌리게 될 것이다. 포도나무는 열매를 맺고, 땅은 곡식을 내고, 하늘은 이슬을 내릴 것이다. 내가 이 백성 가운데 남은 사람들에게 이 모든 것을 그들의 몫으로 주겠다.
ko.R: 씨앗이 평화롭게 자랄 것이다. 포도나무에는 포도가 열리고, 땅에서는 곡식이 나고, 하늘에서는 이슬이 내릴 것이다. 나는 살아남은 사람들에게 이 모든 좋은 것을 주겠다.

pt.L: Porque [haverá] a semente da paz: a videira dará o seu fruto, e a terra dará a sua produção, e os céus darão o seu orvalho; e farei o remanescente deste povo herdar todas estas [coisas].
pt.B: Porque haverá uma semeadura de paz: a videira dará o seu fruto, o solo dará as suas colheitas, e o céu dará o seu orvalho. Darei todas estas coisas ao remanescente deste povo como herança.
pt.R: As sementes vão crescer em paz. As parreiras vão dar uvas. O solo vai produzir colheitas, e o orvalho vai cair do céu. Vou dar todas essas coisas boas às pessoas que restaram.

am.L: የሰላም ዘር [ይሆናል]ና፤ ወይኑ ፍሬውን ይሰጣል፤ ምድሪቱም ፍሬዋን ትሰጣለች፤ ሰማያትም ጠላቸውን ይሰጣሉ፤ ለዚህም ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ይህን ሁሉ አወርሳለሁ።
am.B: የሰላም ዘር ይዘራልና፤ ወይኑ ፍሬውን ይሰጣል፤ መሬቱ ሰብሉን ይሰጣል፤ ሰማይም ጠሉን ይሰጣል። ይህንም ሁሉ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ገንዘባቸው አድርጌ እሰጣለሁ።
am.R: ዘሩ በሰላም ያድጋል። ወይኑ ወይን ያፈራል። መሬቱ ሰብል ያበቅላል፤ ጠልም ከሰማይ ይወርዳል። ይህን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ ለቀሩት ሰዎች እሰጣለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि शान्ति का बीज [होगा]: दाखलता अपना फल देगी, और भूमि अपनी उपज देगी, और आकाश अपनी ओस देगा; और मैं इस प्रजा के बचे हुए लोगों को ये सब [वस्तुएँ] निज भाग करके दूँगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि शान्ति से बोया जाएगा: दाखलता अपना फल देगी, भूमि अपनी उपज देगी, और आकाश अपनी ओस देगा। मैं ये सब वस्तुएँ इस प्रजा के बचे हुए लोगों को उनकी निज संपत्ति करके दूँगा।
hi.R: बीज शान्ति से उगेंगे। दाखलताओं पर अंगूर लगेंगे। भूमि फ़सल देगी, और आकाश से ओस गिरेगी। मैं ये सब अच्छी चीज़ें उन लोगों को दूँगा जो बच गए हैं।

ru.L: Ведь [будет] посев мира: лоза даст свой плод, и земля даст свой урожай, и небеса дадут свою росу; и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам остатку этого народа всё это во владение.
ru.B: Ведь будет мирный посев: лоза принесёт свой плод, земля даст урожай, и небо даст росу. Всё это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдам остатку этого народа во владение.
ru.R: Семена будут расти в мире. Виноградная лоза принесёт виноград. Земля даст урожай, и с неба будет падать роса. Я отдам всё это добро тем, кто остался из народа.

uk.L: Бо [буде] насіння миру: лоза дасть свій плід, і земля дасть свій урожай, і небеса дадуть свою росу; і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам залишкові цього народу все це в спадщину.
uk.B: Бо буде сівба миру: лоза принесе свій плід, земля дасть свій урожай, а небо дасть свою росу. Я дам усе це залишкові цього народу як їхню власність.
uk.R: Насіння ростиме в мирі. Виноградні лози родитимуть виноград. Земля родитиме врожай, і з неба падатиме роса. Я дам усі ці добрі речі людям, що залишилися.

decisions.choice: the seed of peace: the crops will be sown and grow in safety
alternatives: the vine, the plant of peace, will give its fruit
decisions.reason: The phrase is unusual. It most likely means that sowing will be safe and fruitful, with no enemy to destroy the harvest (contrast verse 10). The words can also be joined to what follows, so that the vine itself is "the seed of peace". Either way, the promise is a harvest that comes in safety.

decisions.choice: the vine, the land and the heavens give again: the drought of Haggai's day reversed
decisions.reason: Haggai said that because the temple lay in ruins, "the heavens above you have withheld their dew, and the earth has withheld its produce" (Haggai 1:10-11). Now each of them gives again, as the covenant promised for obedience (Leviticus 26:4; Deuteronomy 28:12).

decisions.choice: I will cause them to possess: give as an inheritance
decisions.reason: The verb is used for giving land or goods as a lasting possession. The remnant will hold these blessings as their own.

decisions.choice: the seed of peace (L); a sowing of peace (B); The seeds will grow in peace (R)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps "peace", the settled word for *shalom*, and says what the phrase means at its own level of plainness.

decisions.choice: "je ferai hériter au reste de ce peuple" (L)
decisions.reason: Keeps the Hebrew causative "cause to inherit"; the construction is strained French, accepted at Literal; Balanced says "en héritage".

decisions.choice: "simiente de paz" (L); "una siembra de paz" (B); "Las semillas crecerán en paz" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is hard; the levels follow the meaning decision, that the crops will be sown and grow in safety.

decisions.choice: शान्ति का बीज (L); शान्ति से बोया जाएगा (B); बीज शान्ति से उगेंगे (R)
decisions.reason: "The seed of peace" means the crops will be sown and grow in safety (meaning m1). Literal keeps the phrase and brackets the verb; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: посев мира (L); мирный посев (B); семена будут расти в мире (R)
decisions.reason: The crops will be sown and grow in safety (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, as the English does.

source.text: וְהָיָ֡ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הֱיִיתֶ֨ם קְלָלָ֜ה בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ וּבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֚ן אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם בְּרָכָ֑ה אַל־תִּירָ֖אוּ תֶּחֱזַ֥קְנָה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, just as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing; do not fear, let be strong your hands.

en.L: And it will be that just as you, house of Judah and house of Israel, became a curse among the nations, so I will deliver you, and you will become a blessing. Do not fear; let your hands be strong.
en.B: House of Judah and house of Israel, just as you were a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and you will become a blessing. So do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.
en.R: People of Judah and Israel, the nations used your name as a curse. But I will save you, and you will be a blessing. So do not be afraid. Take courage and keep working!

fr.L: Et il arrivera que, comme vous avez été une malédiction parmi les nations, maison de Juda et maison d’Israël, ainsi je vous sauverai, et vous serez une bénédiction. N’ayez pas peur ; que vos mains soient fortes.
fr.B: Maison de Juda et maison d’Israël, de même que vous avez été une malédiction parmi les nations, de même je vous sauverai, et vous deviendrez une bénédiction. N’ayez donc pas peur ; que vos mains soient fortes.
fr.R: Peuple de Juda et peuple d’Israël, les nations se servaient de votre nom pour maudire. Mais je vous sauverai, et vous serez une bénédiction. Alors n’ayez pas peur. Courage, continuez le travail !

es.L: Y sucederá que, así como {{plural_you:ustedes fueron|vosotros fuisteis}} maldición entre las naciones, casa de Judá y casa de Israel, así {{plural_you:los|os}} salvaré, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} bendición. No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}; fortalézcanse {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}.
es.B: Casa de Judá y casa de Israel: así como {{plural_you:ustedes fueron|vosotros fuisteis}} una maldición entre las naciones, así {{plural_you:los|os}} salvaré, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} una bendición. Así que no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo; {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}}.
es.R: Pueblo de Judá y de Israel: las naciones usaban {{plural_you:su nombre|vuestro nombre}} como maldición. Pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} salvaré, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} una bendición. Así que no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. ¡{{plural_you:Anímense y sigan|Animaos y seguid}} trabajando!

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, như các ngươi, hỡi nhà Giu-đa và nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã trở thành sự rủa sả giữa các dân tộc thế nào, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ trở thành sự chúc phước thể ấy. Đừng sợ; hãy làm cho tay các ngươi mạnh mẽ.
vi.B: Hỡi nhà Giu-đa và nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, như các ngươi đã là sự rủa sả giữa các dân tộc thế nào, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ trở thành nguồn phước thể ấy. Vậy đừng sợ; hãy vững mạnh lên.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Giu-đa và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, các dân tộc đã dùng tên các ngươi để nguyền rủa. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ là nguồn phước. Vậy đừng sợ. Hãy can đảm lên và tiếp tục làm việc!

sw.L: Na itakuwa kwamba kama vile mlivyokuwa laana kati ya mataifa, enyi nyumba ya Yuda na nyumba ya Israeli, ndivyo nitakavyowaokoa, nanyi mtakuwa baraka. Msiogope; mikono yenu na iwe hodari.
sw.B: Enyi nyumba ya Yuda na nyumba ya Israeli, kama vile mlivyokuwa laana kati ya mataifa, ndivyo nitakavyowaokoa, nanyi mtakuwa baraka. Basi msiogope; mikono yenu na iwe hodari.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Yuda na wa Israeli, mataifa yalitumia jina lenu kama laana. Lakini nitawaokoa, nanyi mtakuwa baraka. Basi msiogope. Jipeni moyo, mwendelee kufanya kazi!

ko.L: 유다 집과 이스라엘 집아, 너희가 민족들 가운데서 저주가 되었던 것처럼, 내가 너희를 구원하여 너희가 복이 될 것이다. 두려워하지 마라. 너희 손을 강하게 하여라.
ko.B: 유다 집과 이스라엘 집아, 너희가 민족들 가운데서 저주의 대상이 되었던 것처럼, 이제 내가 너희를 구원하여 너희가 복이 되게 하겠다. 그러니 두려워하지 말고 힘을 내어라.
ko.R: 유다와 이스라엘 백성아, 민족들은 너희 이름을 저주할 때 써 왔다. 그러나 내가 너희를 구원하겠다. 그러면 너희가 복이 될 것이다. 그러니 두려워하지 마라. 용기를 내어 계속 일하여라!

pt.L: E acontecerá que, assim como vocês, casa de Judá e casa de Israel, foram uma maldição entre as nações, assim eu os salvarei, e vocês serão uma bênção. Não temam; que as mãos de vocês sejam fortes.
pt.B: Casa de Judá e casa de Israel, assim como vocês foram uma maldição entre as nações, assim eu os salvarei, e vocês serão uma bênção. Por isso, não tenham medo; sejam fortes.
pt.R: Povo de Judá e de Israel, as nações usavam o nome de vocês para amaldiçoar. Mas eu vou salvar vocês, e vocês vão ser uma bênção. Por isso, não tenham medo. Tenham coragem e continuem trabalhando!

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የይሁዳ ቤትና የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፣ በሕዝቦች መካከል እርግማን እንደ ሆናችሁ፣ እንዲሁ አድናችኋለሁ፤ በረከትም ትሆናላችሁ። አትፍሩ፤ እጆቻችሁ ይበርቱ።
am.B: የይሁዳ ቤትና የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፣ በሕዝቦች መካከል እርግማን እንደ ነበራችሁ እንዲሁ አድናችኋለሁ፤ በረከትም ትሆናላችሁ። ስለዚህ አትፍሩ፤ እጆቻችሁ ይበርቱ።
am.R: የይሁዳና የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ ሕዝቦች ስማችሁን ለእርግማን ይጠሩት ነበር። እኔ ግን አድናችኋለሁ፤ በረከትም ትሆናላችሁ። ስለዚህ አትፍሩ። አይዟችሁ፤ ሥራችሁንም ቀጥሉ!

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा कि हे यहूदा के घराने और हे इस्राएल के घराने, जैसे तुम जातियों के बीच शाप बन गए थे, वैसे ही मैं तुम्हारा उद्धार करूँगा, और तुम आशीष बनोगे। मत डरो; तुम्हारे हाथ दृढ़ हों।
hi.B: हे यहूदा के घराने और हे इस्राएल के घराने, जैसे तुम राष्ट्रों के बीच शाप बन गए थे, वैसे ही मैं तुम्हारा उद्धार करूँगा, और तुम आशीष बनोगे। इसलिए मत डरो; हियाव बाँधो।
hi.R: हे यहूदा और इस्राएल के लोगो, दूसरे देश शाप देते समय तुम्हारा नाम लेते थे। पर मैं तुम्हें बचाऊँगा, और तुम आशीष का कारण बनोगे। इसलिए मत डरो। हिम्मत रखो और काम करते रहो!

ru.L: И будет: как вы были проклятием среди народов, дом Иуды и дом Израиля, так {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу вас, и вы будете благословением. Не бойтесь; да укрепятся ваши руки.
ru.B: Дом Иуды и дом Израиля, как вы были проклятием среди народов, так {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу вас, и вы станете благословением. Так не бойтесь, будьте крепки.
ru.R: Народ Иуды и Израиля, другие народы произносили ваше имя как проклятие. Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу вас, и вы будете благословением. Поэтому не бойтесь. Мужайтесь и продолжайте работать!

uk.L: І станеться, як ви, доме Юди і доме Ізраїля, були прокляттям серед народів, так {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую вас, і ви станете благословенням. Не бійтеся; нехай зміцняться ваші руки.
uk.B: Доме Юди і доме Ізраїля, як ви були прокляттям серед народів, так {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую вас, і ви станете благословенням. Тож не бійтеся; нехай зміцняться ваші руки.
uk.R: Народе Юди й Ізраїля, народи вживали ваше імʼя як прокляття. Але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую вас, і ви будете благословенням. Тож не бійтеся. Будьте мужні й працюйте далі!

decisions.choice: a curse ... a blessing: a name used in cursing, and a name used in blessing
decisions.reason: To be "a curse among the nations" means that people used Judah's fate as a curse ("may you end up like Judah"), as Jeremiah warned (Jeremiah 24:9; 29:22). Now they will use its name to bless, as the LORD promised Abraham that in him the families of the earth would be blessed (Genesis 12:2-3; compare Genesis 48:20).

decisions.choice: house of Judah and house of Israel: the whole people, south and north
decisions.reason: Both kingdoms are named, as one people again. The promise is wider than the small community in Jerusalem (compare 10:6).

decisions.choice: let your hands be strong: the call of verse 9 repeated
decisions.reason: The section of promises (verses 9-13) begins and ends with the same call to take courage.

decisions.choice: the nations used your name as a curse (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what being "a curse among the nations" means (m1). "Let your hands be strong" keeps the wording of verse 9 at each level.

decisions.choice: the call of verse 9 repeated at each level
decisions.reason: "Fortalézcanse sus manos" (L), "esfuércense" (B) and "Anímense y sigan trabajando" (R) keep the wording of verse 9, as the Hebrew repeats it.

decisions.choice: "nhà Giu-đa và nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L, B) / "dân Giu-đa và dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's "nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L, B) / "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (R), as Jeremiah 31:31; "các ngươi" stays, as in the oracles.

decisions.choice: uma maldição ... uma bênção
decisions.reason: "Maldição" and "bênção", the words the Old Testament terms set (m1); Readable says what being a curse among the nations meant, as the English does (r-en-1). The call at the end keeps each level's words of verse 9.

decisions.choice: शाप ... आशीष (L, B); शाप देते समय तुम्हारा नाम लेते थे ... आशीष का कारण (R)
decisions.reason: A curse and a blessing here are a name used in cursing and a name used in blessing (meaning m1). Literal and Balanced keep the short contrast; Readable says what it means, as the English does. The closing call repeats verse 9 at each level (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: проклятие ... благословение
decisions.reason: A name used in cursing and a name used in blessing (m1); Readable spells out the first, as the English does. "Let your hands be strong" is worded as in verse 9.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַמְ֜תִּילְהָרַ֣ע לָכֶ֗ם בְּהַקְצִ֤יף אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ אֹתִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְלֹ֖א נִחָֽמְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh of hosts: Just as I planned to do harm to you when provoked your fathers me, says Yahweh of hosts, and not I relented,

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Just as I purposed to bring disaster on you when your fathers provoked {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and I did not relent,
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: When your ancestors made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry, I resolved to bring disaster on you and did not relent, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies,
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: When your ancestors made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry, I decided to punish you, and I did not change my mind, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : De même que j’ai résolu de vous faire du mal quand vos pères {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont irrité, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et je n’ai pas renoncé,
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Quand vos ancêtres {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont mis en colère, j’ai décidé de vous frapper de malheur, et je n’y ai pas renoncé, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Quand vos ancêtres {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont mis en colère, j’ai décidé de vous punir, et je n’ai pas changé d’avis, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Así como me propuse hacer{{plural_you:les|os}} mal cuando {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provocaron a ira, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y no me retracté,
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Cuando {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hicieron enojar, decidí traer desgracia sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y no me retracté, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos;
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Cuando {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hicieron enojar, decidí castigar{{plural_you:los|os}}, y no cambié de parecer, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã định giáng tai họa trên các ngươi khi tổ phụ các ngươi chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không đổi ý,
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Khi tổ phụ các ngươi chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quyết định giáng tai họa trên các ngươi và không đổi ý, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán,

ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Когда ваши предки прогневали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} решил навести на вас бедствие и не отступил от этого, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф,
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств: Когда ваши предки разгневали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} решил наказать вас и не передумал, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

uk.L: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот: Як {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} задумав навести на вас лихо, коли ваші батьки гнівили {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не змилосердився,
uk.B: Бо так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ: Коли ваші предки гнівили {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вирішив навести на вас лихо і не відступився від цього, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ,
uk.R: Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель: Коли ваші предки гнівили {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вирішив покарати вас і не передумав, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: I purposed: the same verb as in 1:6
decisions.reason: The ancestors confessed, "Just as the LORD of hosts purposed to deal with us ... so he has dealt with us" (1:6; compare Lamentations 2:17). The LORD now uses the same verb for his new purpose in verse 15.

decisions.choice: I did not relent: I did not turn back from the judgment
decisions.reason: The verb means to change one's mind, to be sorry and turn from a course (Jeremiah 4:28; Jonah 3:10). The judgment of the exile was carried through.

decisions.choice: When your ancestors made me angry (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the time clause first. "Fathers" is "ancestors" at those levels, as in 1:2. The sentence runs on into verse 15, so Literal and Balanced end with a comma.

decisions.choice: "je n'ai pas renoncé" (L), "je n'y ai pas renoncé" (B) for not relenting
decisions.reason: God relenting is "renoncer à" in the French prophets, never "se repentir"; Readable "changer d'avis" as the English.

decisions.choice: "no me retracté"
decisions.reason: God relenting is "retractarse" at L, as the Spanish prophets have it; R says "no cambié de parecer".

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" set inside the sentence at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs from verse 14 into verse 15 with the formula in the middle; Literal keeps it there, while B and R close verse 14 as its own sentence.

decisions.choice: "waliponikasirisha", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English "me" is marked in the Swahili verb by the object marker "-ni-", which cannot take a capital (Swahili style guide 7).

decisions.choice: não desisti (L); não mudei a minha decisão (B); não mudei de ideia (R); planejei (L)
decisions.reason: God's turning from a judgment (m2) takes the wording Jeremiah 4:28 sets in Portuguese at each level; "arrepender-se" would suggest regret for a wrong. "Planejei" at Literal is the verb of 1:6 (m1), so the echo is kept.

decisions.choice: "I purposed" as "አሰብኩ", the verb of 1:6 ("ሊያደርግብን እንዳሰበ") and of verse 15
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes the same Hebrew verb as in 1:6; Literal keeps one Amharic verb for it, so the purpose to harm and the purpose to do good answer each other. Balanced and Readable say "resolved" / "decided" ("ወሰንኩ").

decisions.choice: ठान लेना (L, B), निश्चय करना (R); न पछताया (L), पीछे न हटा (B), मन नहीं बदला (R)
decisions.reason: "Purposed" is the verb of 1:6, ठानी थी there, so the same word is used (meaning m1). "I did not relent" means I did not turn back from the judgment (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: замыслил (L), as 1:6
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 1:6 (m1), so the same word at Literal.

fr.L: de même je reviens, j’ai résolu en ces jours de faire du bien à Jérusalem et à la maison de Juda. N’ayez pas peur.

uk.B: так тепер, у ці дні, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знову вирішив зробити добро Єрусалимові і домові Юди. Не бійтеся.

decisions.choice: I have turned and purposed: I have purposed again, this time for good
decisions.reason: "Turned" used with another verb means doing something again, as in 5:1. The LORD who purposed disaster and carried it through now purposes good, and will carry that through just as surely.

decisions.choice: to do good: the reversal of the harm purposed in verse 14
decisions.reason: "Harm" and "good" stand against each other (compare Jeremiah 29:11; 32:42). "Do not be afraid" repeats verse 13.

decisions.choice: But now I have decided (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "turned and purposed" in plain words.

records.literal_gloss: These [are] the things which you will do: Speak truth each with his neighbor; truth and justice of peace judge in your gates.

en.L: These [are] the things that you shall do: Speak truth, each {{gender:one|man}} with {{gender:their|his}} neighbor; judge with truth and with justice that makes peace, in your gates.
en.B: These are the things you must do: Speak the truth to one another. In your courts, give judgments that are true and just and that make for peace.
en.R: This is what you must do: Tell each other the truth. In your courts, judge fairly and honestly, so that there will be peace.

fr.L: Voici les choses que vous ferez : Dites la vérité, chacun à son prochain ; jugez dans vos portes selon la vérité et un droit qui fait la paix.
fr.B: Voici ce que vous devez faire : Dites-vous la vérité les uns aux autres. Dans vos tribunaux, rendez des jugements vrais et justes, qui apportent la paix.
fr.R: Voici ce que vous devez faire : Dites-vous la vérité les uns aux autres. Dans vos tribunaux, jugez avec justice et honnêteté, pour qu’il y ait la paix.

es.L: Estas [son] las cosas que {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} verdad cada uno con su prójimo; {{plural_you:juzguen|juzgad}} con verdad y con juicio de paz en {{plural_you:sus puertas|vuestras puertas}}.
es.B: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer: {{plural_you:Díganse|Decíos}} la verdad unos a otros. En {{plural_you:sus tribunales|vuestros tribunales}}, {{plural_you:dicten|dictad}} sentencias verdaderas y justas, que traigan la paz.
es.R: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer: {{plural_you:Díganse|Decíos}} la verdad unos a otros. En {{plural_you:sus tribunales|vuestros tribunales}}, {{plural_you:juzguen|juzgad}} con justicia y honradez, para que haya paz.

vi.L: Đây [là] những điều các ngươi phải làm: Hãy nói thật, mỗi người với người lân cận mình; hãy xét xử bằng sự chân thật và bằng công lý đem lại bình an, tại các cổng thành của các ngươi.
vi.B: Đây là những điều các ngươi phải làm: Hãy nói thật với nhau. Tại tòa án của các ngươi, hãy phán xét theo sự thật và công lý để đem lại bình an.
vi.R: Đây là điều các ngươi phải làm: Hãy nói thật với nhau. Tại tòa án, hãy xét xử công bằng và ngay thẳng để có bình an.

sw.L: Haya [ndiyo] mambo mtakayoyafanya: Semeni kweli kila mtu na jirani yake; hukumuni kwa kweli na kwa hukumu iletayo amani malangoni mwenu.
sw.B: Haya ndiyo mambo mnayopaswa kufanya: Ambianeni ukweli ninyi kwa ninyi. Katika mahakama zenu toeni hukumu zilizo za kweli na za haki, zinazoleta amani.
sw.R: Hili ndilo mnalopaswa kufanya: Ambianeni ukweli. Katika mahakama zenu hukumuni kwa haki na kwa uaminifu, ili kuwe na amani.

ko.L: 너희가 행할 일들은 이것이다. 각자 자기 이웃과 더불어 진실을 말하고, 너희 성문들에서 진실과 평화의 정의로 재판하여라.
ko.B: 너희가 해야 할 일은 이것이다. 서로 진실을 말하여라. 너희 법정에서는 참되고 공정하여 평화를 이루는 판결을 내려라.
ko.R: 너희가 해야 할 일은 이것이다. 서로 진실을 말하여라. 법정에서는 공정하고 정직하게 재판하여 평화가 있게 하여라.

pt.L: Estas [são] as coisas que vocês farão: Falem a verdade, cada um com o seu próximo; julguem nas suas portas com verdade e com juízo de paz.
pt.B: Estas são as coisas que vocês devem fazer: Falem a verdade uns aos outros. Nos seus tribunais, deem sentenças verdadeiras e justas, que promovam a paz.
pt.R: É isto que vocês devem fazer: Digam a verdade uns aos outros. Nos seus tribunais, julguem com justiça e honestidade, para que haja paz.

am.L: የምታደርጓቸው ነገሮች እነዚህ ናቸው፦ እያንዳንዱ ከባልንጀራው ጋር እውነትን ተናገሩ፤ በበሮቻችሁ በእውነትና ሰላምን በሚያመጣ ፍርድ ፍረዱ።
am.B: ልታደርጓቸው የሚገቡ ነገሮች እነዚህ ናቸው፦ እያንዳንዳችሁ ለባልንጀራችሁ እውነትን ተናገሩ። በፍርድ ቤቶቻችሁ እውነተኛና ትክክለኛ፣ ሰላምንም የሚያመጣ ፍርድ ስጡ።
am.R: ማድረግ ያለባችሁ ይህ ነው፦ እርስ በርሳችሁ እውነትን ተነጋገሩ። በፍርድ ቤቶቻችሁ ሰላም እንዲሆን በትክክልና በታማኝነት ፍረዱ።

hi.L: ये वे काम [हैं] जो तुम्हें करने हैं: तुम में से हर एक अपने पड़ोसी से सच बोले; अपने फाटकों में सच्चाई से और शान्ति लानेवाले न्याय से न्याय करो।
hi.B: ये वे काम हैं जो तुम्हें करने हैं: तुम में से हर एक अपने पड़ोसी से सच बोले। अपनी अदालतों में ऐसे फ़ैसले करो जो सच्चे और न्यायपूर्ण हों और शान्ति लाएँ।
hi.R: तुम्हें यह करना है: तुम में से हर एक अपने आसपास के लोगों से सच बोले। अपनी अदालतों में न्याय से और ईमानदारी से फ़ैसले करो, ताकि शान्ति बनी रहे।

ru.L: Вот что вы должны делать: говорите истину каждый со своим ближним; истиной и правосудием, [дающим] мир, судите в ваших воротах.
ru.B: Вот что вы должны делать: говорите истину каждый своему ближнему. В ваших судах выносите решения истинные, справедливые и ведущие к миру.
ru.R: Вот что вы должны делать: говорите правду людям вокруг себя. В ваших судах судите справедливо и честно, чтобы был мир.

uk.L: Ось що ви маєте робити: Говоріть правду кожен зі своїм ближнім; судіть правдою і судом, що творить мир, у ваших брамах.
uk.B: Ось що ви маєте робити: Говоріть правду одне одному. У ваших судах виносьте вироки правдиві й справедливі, що ведуть до миру.
uk.R: Ось що ви маєте робити: Кажіть одне одному правду. У ваших судах судіть чесно й справедливо, щоб був мир.

decisions.choice: in your gates: in the courts held at the town gates
decisions.reason: Elders and judges heard cases at the town gate (Deuteronomy 21:19; Ruth 4:1-2; Amos 5:10, 15).

decisions.choice: truth and justice that makes peace: honest verdicts that settle disputes and restore well-being
decisions.reason: "Justice of peace" means judgment that brings peace: it puts things right between the parties so that the community is whole again.

decisions.choice: speak truth each with his neighbor: quoted in Ephesians 4:25
decisions.reason: Paul takes up these words in Ephesians 4:25, telling believers to put away falsehood and speak the truth to one another, because they belong to one another.

decisions.choice: one / man; their / his (L); one another (B); each other (R); courts (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Each with his neighbor" means everyone, so Literal gives it the gender setting and the other levels say "one another". Balanced and Readable say "courts" for "gates" (m1). "Truth" and "peace" keep their settled words.

decisions.choice: "chacun à son prochain" (L) with no gender span
decisions.reason: French "chacun" and "son" are already inclusive; the English needs the span for "man" and "his".

decisions.choice: "Dites la vérité, chacun à son prochain" (L)
decisions.reason: Close to the published Ephesians 4:25, which quotes this verse, as the meaning decision notes.

decisions.choice: "Hablen verdad cada uno con su prójimo"
decisions.reason: L keeps the wording of Ephesians 4:25 L in Spanish, which quotes this line; "cada uno" and "su" need no gender span, as there.

decisions.choice: "en sus puertas" (L); "en sus tribunales" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Courts were held at the town gates; L keeps the gates, B and R say courts, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tại các cổng thành của các ngươi" (L) / "tại tòa án" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Courts sat at the town gate; B and R say what the gate stands for, as the English does. Ephesians 4:25's "hãy nói thật với người lân cận" is echoed at L.

decisions.choice: "Semeni kweli kila mtu na jirani yake" (L); "Ambianeni ukweli" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:25 quotes this line; Swahili keeps the key word "kweli" so a reader can see it. "Malangoni mwenu" (L) becomes "mahakama zenu" (courts) at Balanced and Readable, as the English.

decisions.choice: "각자 자기 이웃과 더불어 진실을 말하고" (L)
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:25 quotes this line (meaning decision); the Korean Ephesians L says "각 사람은 자기 이웃과 더불어 참된 것을 말하십시오", and Literal keeps its "자기 이웃과 더불어". No gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: Falem a verdade, cada um com o seu próximo (L); uns aos outros (B, R); nas suas portas (L), nos seus tribunais (B, R); no gender span
decisions.reason: The command (m3) keeps at Literal the words Ephesians 4:25 has in Portuguese, "falem a verdade, cada um com o seu próximo", which is already inclusive, so there is no gender span where the English Literal has one (r-en-1). Balanced and Readable say "tribunais" for the courts held at the gates (m1), as the English says "courts".

decisions.choice: "Speak truth each with his neighbour" in the words of Ephesians 4:25 on main: "እያንዳንዱ ከባልንጀራው ጋር እውነትን ተናገሩ" (L), "እያንዳንዳችሁ ለባልንጀራችሁ እውነትን ተናገሩ" (B)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line and the Hebrew agrees with his Greek, so the Amharic of Ephesians is kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable follows the English Readable ("tell each other the truth"). "In your gates" is "በበሮቻችሁ" at Literal and "in your courts" ("በፍርድ ቤቶቻችሁ") at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "እያንዳንዱ ከባልንጀራው ጋር" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span like the English one
decisions.reason: "እያንዳንዱ" (each one) and "ባልንጀራ" (neighbour) include women and men, so the English one / man choice has nothing to change, as in Ephesians 4:25.

decisions.choice: तुम में से हर एक अपने पड़ोसी से सच बोले (L, B); अपने आसपास के लोगों से (R)
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:25 quotes this line (meaning m3), and the Hebrew says the same, so each level keeps the wording of Ephesians 4:25 in this translation: "हर एक अपने पड़ोसी से सच बोले" (L, B) and "अपने आसपास के लोगों से सच बोले" (R). Hindi हर एक and अपने already include women and men, so the English Literal's gender span has no Hindi counterpart.

decisions.choice: फाटकों में (L); अदालतों में (B, R)
decisions.reason: Courts were held at the town gates (meaning m1). Literal keeps the gates; Balanced and Readable say अदालत, as the English says "courts".

decisions.choice: говорите истину каждый со своим ближним (L); говорите истину каждый своему ближнему (B); говорите правду людям вокруг себя (R)
decisions.reason: Ephesians 4:25 quotes these words, and the Hebrew says the same, so each level keeps the Russian wording of Ephesians 4:25 at that level. Russian "каждый" needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: в ваших воротах (L); в ваших судах (B, R)
decisions.reason: Courts were held at the town gates (m1); Balanced and Readable say "суды", as the English says "courts".

source.text: וְאִ֣ישׁ׀אֶת־רָעַ֣ת רֵעֵ֗הוּ אַֽל־תַּחְשְׁבוּ֙ בִּלְבַבְכֶ֔ם וּשְׁבֻ֥עַת שֶׁ֖קֶר אַֽל־תֶּאֱהָ֑בוּ כִּ֧י אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖אתִי נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And each the harm of his neighbor do not plan in your heart, and an oath of falsehood do not love; for all these [are things] which I hate, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: And do not devise evil in your hearts {{gender:against one another|each man against his neighbor}}, and do not love a false oath; for all these [are things] that I hate, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not plot evil in your hearts against one another, and do not love false oaths. I hate all these things, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not even think about how to harm one another. Do not love to swear that lies are true. I hate all these things, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et ne méditez pas dans vos cœurs le mal {{gender:les uns contre les autres|chacun contre son prochain}}, et n’aimez pas le faux serment ; car toutes ces [choses], je les hais, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ne tramez pas dans vos cœurs le mal les uns contre les autres, et n’aimez pas les faux serments. Car je déteste tout cela, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne pensez même pas à faire du mal aux autres. N’aimez pas jurer que des mensonges sont vrais. Je déteste tout cela, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:tramen|traméis}} el mal en {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} {{gender:unos contra otros|cada uno contra su prójimo}}, y no {{plural_you:amen|améis}} el juramento falso; porque todas estas [son cosas] que aborrezco, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:tramen|traméis}} en {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} el mal unos contra otros, ni {{plural_you:amen|améis}} los juramentos falsos. Yo aborrezco todas estas cosas, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Ni siquiera {{plural_you:piensen|penséis}} en cómo hacerse daño unos a otros. No {{plural_you:amen|améis}} jurar que una mentira es verdad. Yo odio todas estas cosas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Và đừng mưu tính điều ác trong lòng các ngươi để hại nhau, và đừng ưa thích lời thề dối; vì mọi điều ấy [là những điều] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghét, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Đừng mưu tính điều ác trong lòng để hại nhau, và đừng ưa thích lời thề dối. Ta ghét tất cả những điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ngay cả trong ý nghĩ, cũng đừng tìm cách hại nhau. Đừng thích thề rằng điều dối trá là thật. Ta ghét tất cả những điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

sw.L: Wala msiwaziane mabaya mioyoni mwenu kila mtu dhidi ya jirani yake, wala msipende kiapo cha uongo; kwa maana haya yote [ni mambo] ninayoyachukia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Msipange mioyoni mwenu kutendeana mabaya, wala msipende viapo vya uongo. Ninayachukia mambo haya yote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Msifikirie hata kidogo jinsi ya kudhuruana. Msipende kuapa kwamba uongo ni kweli. Ninayachukia mambo haya yote, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 너희 마음속으로 서로 이웃을 해칠 악을 꾀하지 말고, 거짓 맹세를 사랑하지 마라. 이 모든 것은 내가 미워하는 것들이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 마음속으로 서로 해칠 악을 꾀하지 말고, 거짓 맹세를 좋아하지 마라. 나는 이 모든 것을 미워한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 서로 해칠 생각조차 하지 마라. 거짓말을 참말이라고 맹세하기를 좋아하지 마라. 나는 이 모든 것을 미워한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E não planejem no coração de vocês o mal {{gender:uns contra os outros|cada um contra o seu próximo}}, e não amem o juramento falso; porque todas estas [são coisas] que eu odeio, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Não tramem o mal no coração de vocês uns contra os outros, e não amem os juramentos falsos. Eu odeio todas essas coisas, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Nem pensem em fazer mal uns aos outros. Não gostem de jurar que uma mentira é verdade. Eu odeio todas essas coisas, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: በልባችሁም እያንዳንዳችሁ በባልንጀራችሁ ላይ ክፉ ነገርን አታስቡ፤ የሐሰትንም መሐላ አትውደዱ፤ እነዚህን ሁሉ እጠላለሁና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: በልባችሁ አንዳችሁ በሌላው ላይ ክፉ ነገርን አትጠንስሱ፤ የሐሰት መሐላንም አትውደዱ። እነዚህን ሁሉ እጠላለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: አንዳችሁ ሌላውን እንዴት እንደምትጎዱ እንኳ አታስቡ። ውሸትን እውነት ነው ብሎ መማልን አትውደዱ። እነዚህን ሁሉ እጠላለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और अपने मन में {{gender:एक-दूसरे के विरुद्ध|हर एक अपने पड़ोसी के विरुद्ध}} बुराई की युक्ति न करो, और झूठी शपथ से प्रीति न रखो; क्योंकि इन सब [बातों] से मैं घृणा करता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: अपने मन में एक-दूसरे के विरुद्ध बुराई की योजना न बनाओ, और झूठी शपथ से प्रीति न रखो। इन सब बातों से मैं घृणा करता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: एक-दूसरे को हानि पहुँचाने की बात सोचो भी मत। झूठ को सच बताकर शपथ खाना पसंद मत करो। मैं इन सब बातों से घृणा करता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И зла {{gender:друг против друга|каждый против своего ближнего}} не замышляйте в ваших сердцах, и ложной клятвы не любите; ведь всё это — то, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ненавижу, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Не замышляйте в сердце зла друг против друга и не любите ложных клятв. Всё это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ненавижу, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Даже не думайте о том, как навредить друг другу. Не любите клясться, что ложь — это правда. Я ненавижу всё это, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

uk.L: І не задумуйте в своїх серцях зла {{gender:одне проти одного|кожен проти свого ближнього}}, і не любіть неправдивої присяги; бо все це те, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ненавиджу, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Не задумуйте в серцях зла одне проти одного і не любіть неправдивих присяг. Я ненавиджу все це, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Навіть не думайте про те, як завдати шкоди одне одному. Не любіть присягати, що брехня — правда. Я ненавиджу все це, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the commands of 7:10 and 5:3-4 repeated
decisions.reason: The ban on plotting evil against one another repeats 7:10, and the false oath recalls the flying scroll (5:3-4). What the ancestors refused, the restored people are to do.

decisions.choice: things that I hate: what is utterly against God's character
decisions.reason: Proverbs 6:16-19 lists things the LORD hates, among them a lying tongue and a heart that devises wicked plans.

decisions.choice: against one another / each man against his neighbor (L)
decisions.reason: As in 7:10, the phrase means everyone, and Literal gives it the gender setting. Readable says "swear that lies are true" for "a false oath".

decisions.choice: unos contra otros / cada uno contra su prójimo
decisions.reason: As in 7:10, Spanish has the two wordings the English setting gives, so L keeps the gender span.

decisions.choice: "እያንዳንዳችሁ በባልንጀራችሁ ላይ" (each of you against your neighbour) with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span like the one in 7:10
decisions.reason: In 7:10 the Hebrew says "brother", a male word in Amharic, so there is a span; here it says "neighbour" ("ባልንጀራ"), which already includes women, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: {{gender:एक-दूसरे के विरुद्ध|हर एक अपने पड़ोसी के विरुद्ध}}
decisions.reason: As in 7:10, the Literal gives the inclusive wording by default and the Hebrew picture as the alternative, as the English Literal does; the command repeats 7:10 (meaning m1), and each level repeats that verse's wording.

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: The fast of the fourth and the fast of the fifth and the fast of the seventh and the fast of the tenth will become for [the] house of Judah joy and gladness and festivals good; and the truth and the peace love.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: The fast of the fourth [month], the fast of the fifth, the fast of the seventh and the fast of the tenth will become joy and gladness and good festivals for the house of Judah. So love truth and peace.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become times of joy and gladness and happy festivals for the house of Judah. So love truth and peace.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: The days when you fast in the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful, happy festivals for the people of Judah. So love truth and peace.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Le jeûne du quatrième [mois], le jeûne du cinquième, le jeûne du septième et le jeûne du dixième deviendront pour la maison de Juda joie, allégresse et bonnes fêtes. Aimez donc la vérité et la paix.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Les jeûnes du quatrième, du cinquième, du septième et du dixième mois deviendront pour la maison de Juda des jours de joie et d’allégresse, des fêtes heureuses. Aimez donc la vérité et la paix.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Les jours où vous jeûnez, au quatrième, au cinquième, au septième et au dixième mois, deviendront pour le peuple de Juda des fêtes joyeuses et heureuses. Alors aimez la vérité et la paix.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: El ayuno del [mes] cuarto, el ayuno del quinto, el ayuno del séptimo y el ayuno del décimo serán para la casa de Judá gozo y alegría y fiestas felices. {{plural_you:Amen|Amad}}, pues, la verdad y la paz.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Los ayunos de los meses cuarto, quinto, séptimo y décimo se convertirán para la casa de Judá en tiempos de gozo y alegría y en fiestas felices. Así que {{plural_you:amen|amad}} la verdad y la paz.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Los días en que {{plural_you:ayunan|ayunáis}} en los meses cuarto, quinto, séptimo y décimo se convertirán en fiestas llenas de gozo y alegría para el pueblo de Judá. Así que {{plural_you:amen|amad}} la verdad y la paz.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Kỳ kiêng ăn tháng thứ tư, kỳ kiêng ăn tháng thứ năm, kỳ kiêng ăn tháng thứ bảy và kỳ kiêng ăn tháng thứ mười sẽ trở thành sự vui mừng, sự hân hoan và những kỳ lễ tốt đẹp cho nhà Giu-đa. Vậy hãy yêu chuộng sự chân thật và sự bình an.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Các kỳ kiêng ăn vào tháng tư, tháng năm, tháng bảy và tháng mười sẽ trở thành những dịp vui mừng hân hoan và những kỳ lễ hạnh phúc cho nhà Giu-đa. Vậy hãy yêu chuộng sự chân thật và bình an.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Những ngày các ngươi kiêng ăn vào tháng tư, tháng năm, tháng bảy và tháng mười sẽ trở thành những ngày lễ vui vẻ, hạnh phúc cho dân Giu-đa. Vậy hãy yêu chuộng sự thật và bình an.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Saumu ya [mwezi wa] nne, na saumu ya wa tano, na saumu ya wa saba, na saumu ya wa kumi, itakuwa kwa nyumba ya Yuda furaha na shangwe na sikukuu njema. Basi pendeni kweli na amani.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Saumu za mwezi wa nne, wa tano, wa saba na wa kumi zitakuwa nyakati za furaha na shangwe na sikukuu za kufurahisha kwa nyumba ya Yuda. Basi pendeni kweli na amani.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Siku mnazofunga katika mwezi wa nne, wa tano, wa saba na wa kumi zitakuwa sikukuu za furaha na shangwe kwa watu wa Yuda. Basi pendeni kweli na amani.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 넷째 [달]의 금식과 다섯째 [달]의 금식과 일곱째 [달]의 금식과 열째 [달]의 금식이 유다 집에게 기쁨과 즐거움과 좋은 절기들이 될 것이다. 그러니 진실과 평화를 사랑하여라.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 넷째 달과 다섯째 달과 일곱째 달과 열째 달의 금식이 유다 집에게 기쁨과 즐거움의 때, 흥겨운 절기가 될 것이다. 그러니 진실과 평화를 사랑하여라.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희가 넷째 달과 다섯째 달과 일곱째 달과 열째 달에 금식하던 날들이 유다 백성에게 기쁘고 즐거운 축제가 될 것이다. 그러니 진실과 평화를 사랑하여라.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: O jejum do quarto [mês], o jejum do quinto, o jejum do sétimo e o jejum do décimo se tornarão para a casa de Judá alegria e júbilo e festas felizes. Portanto, amem a verdade e a paz.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Os jejuns do quarto, do quinto, do sétimo e do décimo mês se tornarão para a casa de Judá tempos de alegria e de júbilo e festas felizes. Portanto, amem a verdade e a paz.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: Os dias em que vocês jejuam no quarto, no quinto, no sétimo e no décimo mês vão se tornar festas cheias de alegria para o povo de Judá. Por isso, amem a verdade e a paz.
